name: webmcp-local-relay
description: Relay browser-registered WebMCP tools to any MCP client via localhost WebSocket bridge
long_description: WebMCP Local Relay connects your browser tabs to AI agents like Claude. Websites that register WebMCP tools through document.modelContext are automatically discovered and relayed through a local WebSocket bridge, making them available as standard MCP tools. Tools are dynamically added and removed as you navigate between pages.
